cost: One-step count <=3*n*(n-1), multiplied by <=1+4*(n-2) only at n=3..5. C candidates, F features, W weights: score/choose O(C*F*log W), excluding external lookup cost. Training stores O(sum C*F), scans O(epochs*sum C*F); top sorts O(C log C). No throughput claim.
description: Integer candidate grammar, environment-dependent features, first-max selection, averaged learner and weight publication.
forward: Enumerate distinct ordered mention pairs, canonicalize Add/Mul ordering, and retain representable results. At 3..5 mentions append valid second operations using distinct third indices. Score feature occurrences and choose first strict maximum. Learner retains gold-reachable examples and averages gold-minus-predicted updates.
inverse: Universe: mention arrays, fixed feature context, bounded weights and candidate/choice results. Invalid/reused indices, invalid division, unrepresentable arithmetic and later tied choice winners are absent. This inner absence relation does not exclude scoring overflow outside bounds.

For fixed ordered candidates and features, winner j admits weight vectors with score(j)>score(i) for earlier i and >= for later i. Answer-only observation unions these regions over candidates of that value. Different expressions and training histories remain compatible.
limitations: Partial syntax and source models; finite synthetic evidence.
Text extraction, dictionaries, persistence and teacher effects remain external.
state: Valid distinct candidate indices; no second steps outside n=3..5. Op rejects unrepresentable arithmetic, negative-result subtraction and nonintegral division. Score, margin and learner require no i64 overflow. Fixed external flags/dictionaries are required for text determinism.
